rules.rule: Run /setup-matt-pocock-skills once per repo to bind issue tracker, ready-for-agent triage label and GLOSSARY.md vs GLOSSARY-MAP.md layout.
Separate facts from decisions: dispatch read-only sub-agents to inspect files; ask the user only true product or architectural decisions with a recommended default (P4).
Write settled domain terms to GLOSSARY.md immediately inline — pure vocabulary only, never SQL/TypeScript schemas or spec paragraphs.
Create docs/adr/NNNN-slug.md only when all 3 gates pass: (1) hard to reverse, (2) surprising without context, (3) real trade-off. Index every ADR in DECISION.md.
Never run /clear between /grill-with-docs and /to-spec; verify numeric defaults, ordering guarantees and negative requirements verbatim before publishing the Spec.
Slice Specs into vertical end-to-end tracer bullets under 150k tokens each, never horizontal DB-only or UI-only layers.
Run parallel frontier tickets inside isolated Git worktrees (using-git-worktrees) with fresh context windows so no sub-agent crosses into the Dumb Zone.
Write unit and integration tests against the highest clean public seam of a deep module; never couple tests to private helpers or internal constants.
Prefer deep modules (substantial functionality behind a narrow typed interface with high locality) over fragmented shallow wrappers.
Run /improve-codebase-architecture periodically on high-churn Git hotspots, inspect the HTML Before/After report, and feed chosen candidates through /to-spec.
Follow red-reproduction -> minimize -> hypothesize -> instrument (trace_kit P9) -> root-cause fix -> permanent seam regression test.
Run Spec Reviewer and Standards Reviewer as separate parallel sub-agents (plus Security Reviewer for multi-user, auth, payment or public paths).
Include visual summary, runtime execution trace/screenshot evidence, and explicit One-Way vs Two-Way Door + Blast Radius classification in every PR.
Ratchet review lessons into compiler flags, strict linter rules or seam tests first; prose rules in CODING_STANDARDS.md are the last resort.
Default coding model reasoning effort to medium for exploration/grilling/implementation to avoid premature token bloat; escalate to high only for live QA, security audits or hard bugs.
Never spend agent tokens SSHing to deploy; trigger deterministic CI/CD pipelines on merge to main.

item.symptom: /grill-with-docs asks all questions at once without updating GLOSSARY.md

troubleshooting.item: Verify both grilling and domain-modeling skills exist in .agents/skills/ and ask the agent which skills it loaded.

item.symptom: GLOSSARY.md or docs/adr/ not written during grilling

troubleshooting.item: Invoke /grill-with-docs directly in the root repo session rather than nested inside an external wrapper pipeline.

item.symptom: Spec softens strict constraints from grilling

troubleshooting.item: Confirm /clear was not invoked before /to-spec and audit the Spec line-by-line against settled grilling answers.
